summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a 6-K announcing a cash tender offer for up to $1.0bn aggregate principal of its $3.0bn 6.000% Perpetual Subordinated Contingent Convertible Securities (callable May 22, 2027), at 100.50% of par ($1,005 per $1,000) plus accrued interest. The offer launched November 5, 2026, expires November 19 unless extended, with expected settlement November 24; tenders in $200,000 minimums and $1,000 increments, subject to proration and a Maximum Tender Amount the company may adjust. No board recommendation or advisor named. Framed as proactive Tier 1 capital management; watch take-up, proration and any new-securities pricing.
